steps.label: Sent to Galilee
steps.copy: At the empty tomb the angel tells the women that Jesus is going ahead of them to Galilee.

steps.label: On the mountain
steps.copy: The eleven disciples go to the mountain in Galilee where Jesus had told them to go.

steps.label: Worship and doubt
steps.copy: When they see him they worship him, but some doubt.

steps.label: All authority
steps.copy: “Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them,” and he is with them always.

set.note: Matthew says Joseph came into the land of Israel but, afraid of Archelaus in Judea, turned aside to Galilee. Where he crossed into the land is not recorded.

steps.label: The angel’s word
steps.copy: After Herod dies, an angel tells Joseph in a dream to take the child and his mother back to Israel.

steps.label: To the land of Israel
steps.copy: Joseph gets up and takes the child and his mother into the land of Israel.

steps.label: Turning to Galilee
steps.copy: Afraid of Archelaus, who reigns in Judea, and warned in a dream, he withdraws to Galilee.

steps.label: A home in Nazareth
steps.copy: He settles in a town called Nazareth, fulfilling what the prophets said.

set.note: The Gospels don't name John's prison; the historian Josephus says it was the fortress of Machaerus, east of the Dead Sea.

steps.label: Herod’s banquet
steps.copy: On his birthday Herod gives a banquet for his nobles and officers.

steps.label: A deadly request
steps.copy: Prompted by her mother, the girl asks for the head of John the Baptist on a platter.

steps.label: John beheaded
steps.copy: An executioner is sent and beheads John in the prison.

steps.label: Told to Jesus
steps.copy: John's disciples bury his body and go and tell Jesus.

steps.label: Mark to come along
steps.copy: Barnabas wants to take John Mark; Paul does not, since Mark had deserted them in Pamphylia.

steps.label: Paul takes Silas
steps.copy: After a sharp disagreement they part ways. Paul chooses Silas and is commended to the grace of the Lord.

steps.label: Barnabas sails to Cyprus
steps.copy: Barnabas takes Mark and sails to Cyprus.
